previous_assumption: Auction winner selection was assumed to be fully handled by pickWinningBid's bid-ranking computation — closing an auction and persisting a winning_bid_id in auction_results was treated as equivalent to "the auction is done, formalize the win."
correction: This was a real, confirmed gap: a Rental Company holding the leading bid could complete the entire sourceAuctionId -> CommercialQuotation -> send -> award -> Rental chain with zero Renter action after the initial pre-bid participant approval (assertWonAuction only checked "is this org the bid-ranking leader," never "did the Renter choose you"). Fixed by adding an explicit post-close AuctionService.selectParticipant(userId, renterOrganizationId, auctionId, participantId) — Renter-only (auction.manage), requires auction.status==="closed", target participant must be "approved", one-time/irreversible (rejects if another participant is already "selected"). participantStatusSchema gained a 4th value "selected" (zero migration needed — status is a plain text column). CommercialQuotationService.assertWonAuction was renamed assertSelectedParticipant and now requires the caller's own participant row to have status "selected" (via findParticipantByOrganization), not "is the bid leader" — this one change closes both "winner != selection" and "award to self" simultaneously, since selection is now the sole, Renter-controlled gate. Deliberately scoped to the auction path (sourceAuctionId) only — Path A/B's existing sent->awarded direct transition (no forced negotiation) is a separate, pre-existing, documented decision in docs/marketplace-core-loop-design.md §6 and was NOT reopened.
